business.name: Small Spaces Architects
business.headline: Small spaces. Big ideas.
business.intro: Architects for extensions, renovations and small homes in Melbourne's inner north. A fixed fee for every stage.
business.disclaimer: Sample site made by Oceanalt to show the Professional layout. Not a real architecture practice.

hero.photoAlt: A concrete staircase rising between plain white walls

credentials.text: A fixed fee for every stage

servicesIntro: Most of our work is on houses under 150 square metres, where every metre has to earn its place.

services.name: Extensions and renovations
services.desc: Kitchens, living rooms and second storeys that bring in light without losing the garden.

services.name: Planning permits
services.desc: Drawings, reports and dealing with council until the permit's issued.

services.name: Small homes and granny flats
services.desc: Backyard studios and small dwellings, designed to the new small second dwelling rules.

services.name: Feasibility study
services.desc: What you can build on your block, what it might cost and how long it takes.

feesIntro: Fees are fixed per stage and agreed in writing. You can stop after any stage.

fees.note: Site visit, sketch options and a cost range
Plus council fees, itemised in your quote
Depends on size, usually 6 to 9% of build cost

process.title: A site visit
process.desc: We come to you, walk the house and talk about how you live in it.

process.title: Options on paper
process.desc: Two or three ideas with a cost range for each, before you commit to anything.

process.title: Permit and build
process.desc: We draw it, get it approved and help you choose a builder.

faq.q: Do you work outside the inner north?
faq.a: Yes, across Melbourne. Most of our projects are within half an hour of Fitzroy.

faq.q: How long does a permit take?
faq.a: Usually three to five months, depending on the council. We tell you where it's up to every fortnight.

faq.q: Can you work to a fixed budget?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the number at the start and we design to it, with a builder's estimate before drawings are final.

contactIntro: Book a site visit, or save our details and call when it suits you.
